'''Mike Downey''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Ohio State Championship]] on 15 April 2000 with [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|HBX (Hidden Base X-wings)]], according to Frank Lamantia's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d551">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-18-columbus-ohio-4-15-00-statesd551/ columbus-ohio-4-15-00-states], DeckTech (Frank "FrankLamanti" Lamantia, 18 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-18-columbus-ohio-4-15-00-statesd551/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
